name: Stalk With The Earthmother
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
narrative.objectives: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: That was quite a display, champion.  Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity.I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you.  Good luck on your travels, champion.  The Horde will need heroes like you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have something for me?
